requirements.description: Model Monica mandates that the model must achieve at least 95% accuracy on the test set to meet product guidelines.
Model Monica requires that model training leverages deep learning architectures.
Model Monica prefers PyTorch over other machine learning frameworks.
Model Monica is frustrated by requests to simplify model architectures solely for resource constraints.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that model inference latency must remain under 50ms to prevent user experience degradation.
Efficiency Emilia requires model training resource footprint to remain within budget limits.
Efficiency Emilia prefers simpler models if they provide comparable business value.
Efficiency Emilia is concerned about high cloud costs associated with unnecessarily complex model architectures.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that the chosen MLOps platform must have a predictable monthly SaaS pricing plan.
Efficiency Emilia requires the platform to be hosted and managed by a 3rd party to minimize development overhead.
Efficiency Emilia prefers platforms that offer integrated visual analytics dashboards.
Efficiency Emilia is worried that building a custom platform will delay the release timeline by several months.
Requirements Reuben mandates that the platform must comply with strict internal data security and privacy guidelines.
Requirements Reuben requires that the architecture design supports custom plugin integrations.
Requirements Reuben prefers an open-source core platform to avoid vendor lock-in.
Requirements Reuben is stressed by potential legal and compliance liabilities of 3rd-party SaaS platforms.
Automation Alex mandates that deployment templates must use standard IaC declarations to enable automated provisioning.
Automation Alex requires the platform design to support standard automated deployment pipelines.
Automation Alex prefers containers and Docker for runtime packaging consistency.
Automation Alex is frustrated when custom platform designs ignore operational automation.
Reliability Ruth mandates that the platform architecture must support multi-zone failover configurations.
Reliability Ruth requires the platform to define system-level uptime SLAs.
Reliability Ruth prefers standardized system telemetry integrations.
Reliability Ruth is anxious about high maintenance overheads of debugging custom-built platforms.
Data Dave mandates that data snapshot versioning must be immutable to ensure reproducibility of training sets.
Data Dave requires versioned data lineage graphs to be maintained for all feature transformations.
Data Dave prefers automated detection of upstream schema changes.
Data Dave is frustrated by models trained on ad-hoc, unversioned datasets.
Reliability Ruth mandates that data pipeline failures must trigger automated alerts to on-call engineers.
Reliability Ruth requires real-time data ingestion latency to be actively monitored.
Reliability Ruth prefers unified logging platforms for data flow tracking.
Reliability Ruth is worried that outdated data signal snapshots will silently degrade model predictions.
Requirements Reuben mandates that all snapshot datasets must comply with GDPR privacy rules and strip PII.
Requirements Reuben requires access-control permissions to be implemented for raw and snapshotted data.
Requirements Reuben prefers encrypting snapshots using customer-managed KMS keys.
Requirements Reuben is concerned that hasty data capture will bypass standard security audits.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that storage costs for data snapshots must remain within the monthly budget.
Efficiency Emilia requires unused intermediate data snapshots to be pruned automatically.
Efficiency Emilia prefers using Parquet storage format for cost-efficient querying.
Efficiency Emilia is stressed by high storage costs from redundant historical snapshots.
Data Dave mandates that all feature inputs must be documented in a shared feature store to prevent duplication.
Data Dave requires strict validation rules to be enforced for feature inputs.
Data Dave prefers feature store integrations with automated schema updates.
Data Dave is frustrated by feature entanglement where weight changes cause unpredictable bugs.
Model Monica mandates that the ensemble model accuracy must exceed the baseline single-model accuracy.
Model Monica requires ensemble component models to be trained on independent features.
Model Monica prefers models that support gradient-based feature importance evaluation.
Model Monica is concerned that complex ensemble modeling will lead to overfitting and debug complexity.
Requirements Reuben mandates that model training artifacts must be registered in a secure model registry.
Requirements Reuben requires all training packages to be scanned for license compliance.
Requirements Reuben prefers pre-approved open source libraries for custom code.
Requirements Reuben is worried that complex model dependencies will introduce security vulnerabilities.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that the compute budget for training the ensemble model must not exceed the baseline limit.
Efficiency Emilia requires model training duration to fit within standard spot instance timeouts.
Efficiency Emilia prefers using simpler base estimators to save compute resources.
Efficiency Emilia is frustrated by long training runs that incur high costs without guaranteed gains.
Automation Alex mandates that all production model updates must be triggered and validated via CI/CD pipelines.
Automation Alex requires the deployment pipeline to run automated integration tests.
Automation Alex prefers standardized Kubernetes templates for deployment.
Automation Alex is frustrated by manual release procedures and ad-hoc hotfixes.
Requirements Reuben mandates that validation checks must include automated fairness and bias verification steps.
Requirements Reuben requires the model validation report to be generated and signed off automatically.
Requirements Reuben prefers human-in-the-loop approvals for ethical validations.
Requirements Reuben is worried that fully automated validation pipelines will ignore critical fairness issues.
Reliability Ruth mandates that model release processes must support automatic rollback to the previous version on failure.
Reliability Ruth requires the canary deployment configuration to monitor system error rates during rollouts.
Reliability Ruth prefers rolling updates to prevent temporary system capacity drops.
Reliability Ruth is anxious about deploying fully automated changes during peak traffic hours.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that automated cloud compute scaling limits must be configured to prevent budget runaway.
Efficiency Emilia requires the CD pipeline to compile billing reports for each model deployment.
Efficiency Emilia prefers serverless runtimes for low-traffic endpoints to save costs.
Efficiency Emilia is worried that excessive testing environments will burn through department budgets.
Efficiency Emilia mandates that retraining triggers must activate automatically when business metrics drop below baseline.
Efficiency Emilia requires the retraining cycle to complete within 2 hours to limit business disruption.
Efficiency Emilia prefers simple data windowing techniques for retraining updates.
Efficiency Emilia is stressed by business revenue losses during periods of degraded model accuracy.
Reliability Ruth mandates that a baseline model validation gate must verify performance on historical datasets.
Reliability Ruth requires real-time model performance metrics to be monitored in production.
Reliability Ruth prefers standardized alerting rules for prediction drift.
Reliability Ruth is anxious that automated retraining without diagnostics will deploy corrupt weights.
Model Monica mandates that a baseline model validation gate must verify performance on historical datasets.
Model Monica requires retraining data to be selected to balance class distributions and prevent bias.
Model Monica prefers manual retraining review prior to deploying updated model weights.
Model Monica is anxious about retraining with drifted data without a thorough quality validation.
Requirements Reuben mandates that retrained models must be checked for adversarial vulnerabilities before reactivation.
Requirements Reuben requires all retraining executions and parameters to be logged in the audit trail.
Requirements Reuben prefers utilizing standardized automated compliance checks.
Requirements Reuben is concerned that hasty retraining to address accuracy drops will introduce compliance issues.
